                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ D/(v - u) = 2 x D/(v + u)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ v + u = 2 x (v - u)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ 9 + u = 2(9 - u)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ 3u = 9

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ u = 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ ਸਹੀ ਜਵਾਬ 3 ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The definite article "the" is used for specific, known entities, or things previously mentioned.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In the context of the given sentence, "the cold day today" implies a specific cold day that has already been mentioned, which is not the case.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The indefinite article "a" is used for non-specific, singular countable nouns, indicating any instance of the thing being referred to.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Therefore, the correct phrase should be "a cold day today."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Thus, the grammatical error is in part 2 of the sentence.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.\n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The child played the video game as much as he wanted to.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is 'To his heart's content'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The most appropriate idiom for the underlined part is 'To his heart's content'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The idiom "to his heart's content" means doing something as much or as long as one desires or pleases. In the context of the sentence, it indicates that the child played the video game for as long as he desired or until he was fully satisfied.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The other options do not fit the context:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • "To gild the pill" means to make something unpleasant seem more acceptable but doesn't convey the sense of doing something to one's satisfaction.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • "To kick the bucket" means to die or pass away and doesn't relate to the context of the child playing a video game.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • "To assume airs" means to pretend to have a more important or grander personality and doesn't relate to doing something to one's satisfaction.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Thus, the correct answer is Option 1.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Correct Answer: To his heart's content.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          We hope that we shall win the match against Australia.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "It is hoped that the match against Australia shall be won by us."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "It is expected that the match against Australia should be won by us."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "It is hoped that the match against Australia was won by us."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "It is sure that the match against Australia was won by us."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is 'It is hoped that the match against Australia shall be won by us.'

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The given sentence is in  Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The structure of the given sentence is as follows:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The given sentence has two clauses.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • When a principle clause is followed by a noun clause as an object, the passive voice is made as follows:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Principle clause + conjunction + noun clause. (Active Voice)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • It + is/am/are + verb + by + object + conjunction + noun clause. (Passive Voice) 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • "It" is often used as a placeholder subject in passive voice constructions when the original subject isn't explicitly stated or when the focus is on the action rather than the doer of the action.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • In the provided sentence, "It is hoped by us that the match against Australia shall be won," "It" serves as a placeholder subject in the passive construction, allowing the sentence to emphasize the action of hoping for a victory in the match without focusing on who is doing the hoping.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • We hope that Hansa will clear the exam.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • It is hoped that Hansa will clear the exam.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t​

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Correct Sentence: It is hoped that the match against Australia shall be won by us.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The sentence is discussing cultures that have not yet developed advanced technology or complex social systems.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word "structures" in this context refers to the organization or arrangement of social systems within these cultures.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • It implies the various components, arrangements, or systems that these cultures have in place to organize themselves socially, economically, and culturally.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • These could include social norms, traditions, customs, and community frameworks that define the functioning of their societies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Therefore, "structures" is the most suitable term here to describe the absence of complex social systems in these cultures that are considered "primitive."

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Correct Passage: Primitive cultures are those that exist in societies that have not yet developed advanced technology or complex social structures These cultures are often characterised by their close relationship with the natural world. Despite being considered 'primitive', these cultures have a rich history and a unique way of life that is (2)__________ studying and preserving. These cultures often have a deep understanding of the environment and its cycles, and they have developed intricate systems of knowledge and belief that are closely tied to nature. For example, indigenous cultures in the Amazon rainforest have an (3)_______ knowledge of the medicinal properties of plants and the cycles of the seasons, which they use to sustain themselves and their communities. Another important aspect is that these cultures often have complex systems of kinship and social hierarchy.
